metadata.title: हेमंत सोरेन या विक्टर कुमार मालतो: झारखंड की समस्या कौन | Victor Kumar Malto V/S Hemant Governmen
metadata.description: In this incisive interview, Victor Kumar Malto — national convener of the Adivasi Budhijivi Manch and a leading voice in the PESA movement — responds to the Jharkhand High Court’s decision to halt the auction of minor minerals. With the state government yet to notify the PESA rules, Mr. Malto raises serious questions about the government’s intentions and its commitment to protecting tribal rights. He explains why the delay in implementing PESA is not just a legal lapse but a direct challenge to the constitutional safeguards meant for Adivasi communities. Through sharp analysis and grounded experience from the field, Mr. Malto argues that the government’s hesitation reflects deeper structural disregard for Gram Sabhas and Adivasi autonomy. This conversation offers a crucial perspective on the ongoing PESA debate in Jharkhand.
